description: This Java class 'JwtConfig' is part of a security package for a book tracking application. It manages JWT (JSON Web Token) configuration, including generating tokens, defining expiration periods, and creating HTTP cookies for refresh tokens.

classes.name: JwtConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for managing JWT tokens, including creation, expiration, and refresh token handling within a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: getAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Returns the standard HTTP Authorization header name.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for the provided Authentication object; distinguishes between access and refresh tokens based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Helper method to construct a JWT token string with specified expiration, subject, and authorities.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenCookie
methods.description: Creates a secure, HTTP-only cookie containing a refresh token.
